meta.blind: No symbol of creilly's records.json (or any other transcription) was read before this file was committed
meta.readers: 8 reader agents (readers1/) transcribed every page; 3 second readers (readers2/) re-read 24 pages independently
meta.ocr: template OCR (ocr*.py, ocr_templates.npz) as a second channel on every page; compared group by group
meta.conventions: lines: as printed, groups separated by one space, parentheses kept; symbols: letters as printed (any A-Z), '-' a printed lost mark, '?' unreadable; annotation tokens dropped
